question: Can an existing repository adopt causal Git memory and durable agent work state without changing its language, package manager or legacy history?
hypothesis: One idempotent init command plus a reusable CI workflow can establish causal history, durable WORK refs and integration-boundary rules while exempting only the bootstrap commit.

decision.reason: The init path is idempotent in an isolated Git repository and a separate legacy-style fixture branch completed the reusable workflow end-to-end from an unstructured bootstrap commit. CI validated the bootstrap boundary, generated the causal report, and attached success evidence in refs/notes/usegit without rewriting legacy history or changing the target stack.
